SECURITY_EVALUATION_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL_D.description: Days to keep 'not-relevant' verdict cache rows before they expire. Hard-hit rows are audit-only and never expire.

SECURITY_EVALUATION_CODE_SCAN_VERDICT_CA.description: Days to keep code-scan LLM verdict cache rows before they are re-judged. Content or version changes already invalidate the cache key; the TTL only forces long-unchanged files to be re-judged against model drift (ADR-054).

SECURITY_EVALUATION_WEB_ORIGIN_VERIFICAT.description: Days between ownership re-verifications of a web-origin asset. Re-verification is lazy: it runs the next time the host submits assets, not on a scheduler (ADR-044).

SECURITY_EVALUATION_WEB_ORIGIN_REVERIFY_.description: Consecutive failed re-verifications before a web origin drops to FAILED and stops being evaluated. Protects against scanning a domain that changed hands (ADR-044).

SECURITY_EVALUATION_WEB_ORIGIN_TOKEN_BYT.description: Random bytes of the verification token (base64url-encoded, at most 48 bytes to fit VarChar(64)).
